steps.npc: Oh, wonderful! Looks like someone has managed to break another prototype. If only I'd given a long and detailed lecture on the correct usage of it. How silly of me!
What? Oh, yes, everything is just fantastic! After all, how could anything be wrong when you have such competent colleges who continuously surprise you in ways you'd never imagine!

steps.player: Er... Well, that's... good to hear.

steps.npc: It is, isn't it? It's just brilliant, isn't it? Isn't it just totally brilliant to be surrounded by individuals who redefine the definition of genius! Fantastic! Brilliant!
